text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued, June 10, 2023, Appeal DDRT2023-22.

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Denied the request from the Applicant for an in-person hearing as the test was not met that proceeding by electronic means would cause the party significant prejudice. 2. Granted the request from the Applicant for an adjournment until its meeting on February 22, 2024.
